Riley CSM: Hey team — kickoff for PacificWell onboarding. Want to align on stakeholders, pilot success metrics, timeline, and any upfront renewal risks. Quick sync Wed 9am PT?
Alex (AM): Wed 9 works. Who from PacificWell will be on the call?
Maya PM: I (Maya) and our infra lead Leo will join. Security (Dana) maybe on standby.
Riley CSM: Draft agenda: 1) pilot success criteria + measurement, 2) SSO & data residency, 3) sandbox/prod cutover checklist, 4) enablement plan + workshop, 5) renewal checkpoint & risk flags.
Priya Eng: For infra I need expected traffic profile, model sizes, and retention needs. Please paste numbers before Wed.
Maya PM: Baseline 1 req/s, peak 12 req/s during spikes. Models are medium (7B). Data retention: logs 30 days, audit logs permanent.
Jordan SE: Proposed success criteria: a) p95 latency <350ms, b) error rate <1.5%, c) two end-to-end flows validated and signed-off. If not met by day 21 post-activation, mark as "needs remediation" for renewal.
Alex (AM): Renewal cadence? If pilot passes, what's timeline to procurement?
Riley CSM: Renewal checkpoint = 60 days after pilot start. AM triggers procurement enablement if metrics and ROI checks are positive; otherwise CSM+AM open remediation plan.
Priya Eng: I'll provision a dev sandbox pool, + a canary namespace for their team. Request: service account details and exact CIDR for IP allowlist.
Maya PM: Sending CIDR + security contact (Dana) inline after this. Also Dana will send KMS and compliance checklist.
deploy-bot: Canary plan scheduled: build pw-310 -> canary 15% traffic on Tue 11pm PT. Logs: https://deploys.example/pw-310
Riley CSM: Enablement: Jordan, can you do a 45-min tech workshop in week 2? Jordan SE: Yep, will do a recorded session + labs.
Priya Eng: Flagging a potential cost/risk: sustained >10 req/s may need temporary reserved capacity. We'll estimate cost and add to risk register.
Riley CSM: Action items before Wed: 1) PacificWell to confirm CIDR + KMS spec (Maya), 2) traffic numbers + flows (Maya), 3) Priya to confirm sandbox sizing, 4) Jordan to draft workshop outline, 5) Riley to share success criteria doc.
Alex (AM): I'll prep procurement pre-reqs and pricing scenarios to discuss.
Maya PM: Thanks — see you Wed.
Priya Eng: One more note: if they require EU-only residency we'll need Private deployment path; that's a timeline/cost call.
Riley CSM: Noted. Adding residency as a primary renewal-risk flag.
Alex (AM): :thumbsup: meeting invite incoming.
